programme.title: Krishna Arjun

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam

programme.title: Khakee: The Real Police

programme.desc: When Natwars elder brother is framed for bribery, he decides to avenge his brothers humiliation and thus poses as a crime lord.

programme.title: Nazar Ke Samne

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Anu and Siddhu are in love and Siddhu turns up when Anus family camps in a tiger sanctuary for a holiday. Unexpectedly, a sandalwood smuggler takes several members as hostages.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Gurus father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: Mela

programme.title: Hiraasat

programme.title: Prince
